judged_text: The embed flow has exactly two states — topic found, or 'loading' with a 30-second reload — and no terminal error state for retrieval that can never succeed. Every permanent failure mode in this diff (nil extracted content, oversized embed_url, malformed feed link) leaves each visitor's browser reloading the iframe every 30 seconds and the server re-enqueuing RetrieveTopic every 60 seconds indefinitely, with the reader never told that anything failed.

adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` returns nil it unconditionally enqueues `:retrieve_topic` and renders `embed/loading` (which `setTimeout` reloads every 30s). There is no terminal error path if retrieval can never succeed. This is verifiable for at least one permanent failure mode shown in the diff: the controller does not validate that `params[:embed_url]` matches `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, but `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` will refuse to retrieve if `URI(@embed_url).host` differs, so the embed will never be created and the iframe will reload forever while requests keep re-enqueuing the job. Similar “never creates TopicEmbed” outcomes exist when `TopicEmbed.import` returns early for non-HTTP(S) URLs (`return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`) or when feed items have malformed links, with no user-visible error state.
